title: A finite separable field extension is etale
statement: Let $k'/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is finite ($\dim_kk'<\infty$) and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then the morphism of affine schemes $\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ induced by the inclusion $k\to k'$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U3 (lemma-etale-over-field, line 39394), 'if' direction, second paragraph of the proof: $k'=k(\alpha)\cong k[x]/(f)$ with $\gcd(f,f')=1$, so $\mathrm d:k'\cdot f\to k'\cdot\mathrm dx$ is an isomorphism and $k\to k'$ is etale (Definition 00U1).
